RF-F003.description: RF-F002 plus two mandatory fixed S2P port parasitics, k limits chip-neighbor/PCB-pair <=0.10, variable C up to 2 branches per 0..3pF Q35; system-level external-port GT/IL/H2/H3.

RF-T005.description: Phase 2 trial: up to three variable-C branches (per branch 0..3pF Q35), RF-F003 base otherwise unchanged.

RF-T006.description: Phase 2 F003-based trial: no component relaxation, two variable-C branches; additional external-port 3..6GHz full-LPF attenuation >=20dB in all six settings (inclusive 1MHz grid).

RF-T007.description: Phase 2 trial based on RF-F003, RF-T005-equivalent max 3 DTC Q35 0..3pF plus non-removable fixed 0.5pF/Q40 per ground-shunt DTC. Bridge/series DTC unchanged; fixed S2Ps and all other RF-F003 conditions retained.

RF-T008.description: Phase 2 RF-T008 rev3 (owner 2026-10-20): up to TWO installed IC variable-C branches, each with one common IC fixed C in parallel. Cfix hot-hot 0.2..3pF/Q60 or hot-GND 0.5..3pF/Q60; Cvar 0..3pF/Q35 independently per setting. PCB-C ground 0.02..1pF/Q60, hot-hot 0.02..0.2pF/Q40 total max3. RF-F003, T005/T006/T007 unchanged.
